headline: CIP Asks Government for Measures to Combat Rising Energy Costs for Companies
summary: CIP has asked the Portuguese government for measures against successive energy price increases, which it says are eroding the competitiveness of the Portuguese economy.
why: CIP is Portugal's main business confederation, representing industrial companies, and energy costs weigh heavily on manufacturing margins and exports.
